notes.title: Version 1.1 (6433)
notes.notes:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a sensitivity slider in the "Gameplay" section of the options menu to tweak the sensitivity of turning with a mouse or gamepad
[*]On the Nexus hub world - once the first level is complete - your speed will now ramp up over time (2x speed after 8 seconds) to reduce time spent on uninterrupted walking sections
[*]Increased the contrast on the active crosshair and added a slider in the options menu to control the opacity of the idle crosshair
[*]A warning prompt will now be displayed when selecting "New Game" from the main menu to prevent accidental deletion of an existing save file
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Gamepad input should now correctly allow variable movement speed
[*]Removed a section from level 8 (VIII) that was causing issues for some players
[*]Upon re-entering the game, the player should no longer be sometimes taken to a part of the Nexus they haven't progressed to yet
[*]Fixed some issues with using a keyboard or gamepad to navigate the UI
[/list]

notes.title: Build 6432: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We've just pushed a new build to Steam that should fix two major issues:

[olist]
[*]There was an issue causing multiple graphical problems: a lack of shadows, over-brightening of the environment, and artefacts on some of the VFX. As a result of fixing this, the game should look better overall.
[*][strike]For some people, throwing boxes while on moving platforms was causing them to fall off the platform. Hopefully this build will fix the issue (unconfirmed)[/strike] Confirmed not to work, the offending puzzle element has been completely removed in version 1.1
[/olist]
